text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During the Representative Exchange Race, 
Manhattan Cafe slowed down right before 
the finish line. However, no abnormalities 
were found with her legs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was as if someone had called out to 
stop her—a sudden deceleration, as though 
something was alerting her to her body's 
limits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe decided that now wasn't the 
right time to aim for the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe, and chose to decline her spot as 
Japan's representative.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> was selected as Japan's representative. 
The current <chrname> is the vision of Manhattan 
Cafe's future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She commits herself entirely to a support 
role. All for the day she will eventually 
challenge the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe 
herself.
